agentRuns:
I fixed the `tools-ai-sdk` build failure; both the typecheck and the declaration build that was failing now pass. I didn't run the full `tsup` build itself, because running it needed approval.

**Cause:** with AI SDK 7, `tool()` returns a type that refers to internal types from `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` and `@ai-sdk/provider`. TypeScript can't write those types into a `.d.ts` file (error TS2883, "the inferred type ... cannot be named"). `resolveLibraryId` and `queryDocs` had no return type annotation, so generating declarations failed. tsup reported this under `src/agents/index.ts` because that file imports the tools. A plain `tsc --noEmit` doesn't show these errors, because they only appear when TypeScript writes declarations.

**Fix:** two small edits, each importing `type Tool` from `ai` and adding an explicit return type.
- `src/tools/query-docs.ts:33`: returns `Tool<{ libraryId: string; query: string }, string>`
- `src/tools/resolve-library-id.ts:33`: returns `Tool<{ query: string; libraryName: string }, string>`

These are the same types the functions returned under v6, so their signatures and runtime behavior are unchanged. I didn't use any casts or `@ts-` comments. The working tree had no codemod changes, so there was nothing to revert.

**Checks:**
- `npx --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly`, writing to the scratchpad, used to give 10 errors in those two files and now passes.
- `npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes.
